title: Password reset token: expiry and single use
prompt:
In this directory, create a Python file named reset.py.

It must provide two functions for password reset tokens:

  issue(user_id) -> token       returns a new token string for that user
  check(token) -> bool          returns True if the token may be used right now

Requirement, in the words of the person who asked for it:

  A password reset link must stop working 15 minutes after it was issued,
  and a link must not work more than once.

Use only the Python standard library. Do not create any other files.
